point_relative_meaning.statement: A lot of Dieux Instant Angel was wasted because of the tube dispensing issue.

quote.exact_quote: When I first purchased this moisturizer directly from the brand, I immediately thought it smelled rotten, and I thought it had gone bad. Additionally, upon first opening the product, it just gushed out of the tube. A lot of the product was wasted. There is no way to travel with this moisturizer because of the waste. I also did not receive a key to get everything from the tube. The cream stayed stinky on my skin for quite some time after using it. I thought I had completely wasted my money, but then my skin actually looked great the next day. I used it for months and think the product is good. I took a small break from using the product in summer, and when I opened it up to use recently, there was black discoloration on the packaging near the opening. I think this came from the stupid metal tube. Tldr: the cream stinks, and the packing is 0/10. However, the actual moisturizer is good. I don't know if I will repurchase. There are lots of similar creams that have no smell or smell better with much better packaging.

quote.exact_quote: I loved the moisturizer but I wasted like a quarter because of the dumb tube they put it in. The product is way too watery for the packaging and everything gunked up on the cap, and literally every time I opened it, barely touching the tube, excess product would keep coming out. Maybe I'm dumb and it's used error but I won't be purchasing it again due to the price point and the waste thanks to the tube. I like what they were going for with the aluminum tube but it didn't work at all with the consistency of the moisturizer.
